business_summary: Modernized Fund Transfer Service replacing legacy JSF TransferManagedBean and EJB TransferProcessingService. Implements strict two-party fund movement with positive-amount validation, balance threshold enforcement, active account compliance, and atomic CICS mainframe gateway settlement (TX9021).

business_rules.description: Transfer amount must be strictly positive
business_rules.condition: Transfer request initiated with amount parameter
business_rules.action_or_outcome: Validate amount > 0.00; reject with validation error if amount <= 0.00 or null

business_rules.description: Source account must exist in ledger and be in active standing
business_rules.condition: Transfer request with source account identifier
business_rules.action_or_outcome: Verify account exists in AccountRepository and status == 'ACTIVE'; reject if inactive or missing

business_rules.description: Source account must possess sufficient available funds
business_rules.condition: Source account balance is evaluated against requested transfer amount
business_rules.action_or_outcome: Verify account balance >= transfer amount; reject with insufficient funds error if balance < amount

business_rules.description: Daily cumulative transfer limit ceiling of $50,000.00
business_rules.condition: Transfer amount exceeds single-transaction or daily cumulative cap
business_rules.action_or_outcome: Enforce daily transfer limit ceiling of $50,000.00 per account per business day

business_rules.description: External settlement dispatch via CICS Transaction Gateway (TX9021)
business_rules.condition: All validations pass and balances verified
business_rules.action_or_outcome: Dispatch atomic fund settlement to CICS mainframe gateway using transaction code TX9021 and obtain correlation ID

scenarios.name: Successful fund transfer with CICS settlement
given: A valid and active source account 'ACC-1001' with balance $5,000.00
A valid destination account 'ACC-2002' with status 'ACTIVE'
A requested transfer amount of $250.00 within the $50,000.00 daily limit ceiling
scenarios.when: A fund transfer is submitted from 'ACC-1001' to 'ACC-2002' for $250.00
then: The transaction should be dispatched to CICS mainframe gateway with transaction code TX9021
A settlement correlation ID must be received from the mainframe
The source account 'ACC-1001' balance should be updated to $4,750.00
The destination account 'ACC-2002' balance should be credited by $250.00
The transaction status returned to the caller should be SUCCESS

scenarios.name: Reject transfer when amount is zero or negative
given: An invalid transfer amount of $0.00 or negative amount
scenarios.when: The transfer request is submitted with amount <= 0.00
then: The request must be rejected with validation error 'Transfer amount must be greater than zero'
No ledger debit or credit operations must occur
No external CICS mainframe dispatch must be initiated

scenarios.name: Reject transfer when source account has insufficient balance
given: An active source account 'ACC-1001' with balance $100.00
scenarios.when: A fund transfer of $500.00 is requested
then: The system must reject the transaction with error 'Insufficient funds'
No debit or credit operations should occur on either account

scenarios.name: Reject transfer exceeding daily ceiling limit of $50,000.00
given: An active source account 'ACC-1001' with balance $100,000.00
scenarios.when: The fund transfer request is submitted
then: The transaction must be rejected for exceeding the daily transfer limit ceiling of $50,000.00
A compliance audit event must be logged

scenarios.name: Reject transfer when source account is not in active standing
given: A source account 'ACC-1001' with status 'SUSPENDED' or 'FROZEN'
scenarios.when: A fund transfer of $100.00 is submitted
then: The transaction must be rejected with compliance error 'Source account is not active'
No CICS settlement should be dispatched

data_contract_fields.sourceAccountId: String - ISO 20022 compliant source account identifier
data_contract_fields.amount: BigDecimal - Transaction monetary amount (precision 18, scale 2, strictly positive)
data_contract_fields.correlationId: String - CICS host transaction correlation UUID

legacy_traceability.com.legacy.banking.web.TransferManagedBe: Presentation action entry point for initiating transfer requests
legacy_traceability.com.legacy.banking.service.TransferProce: Core transaction orchestration, validation, and settlement coordination
legacy_traceability.com.legacy.banking.gateway.CicsMainframe: Mainframe settlement via CICS Transaction Gateway with transaction code TX9021
legacy_traceability.com.legacy.banking.repository.AccountRep: Account entity retrieval and existence check
Local database ledger balance debit/credit updates post-settlement
